mu_name_from: Devias's object slot 11, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object3/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under a dv_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing as nr_ is for Noria: assets/textures is one flat pool, and 39 of Object3's sheet names are already in it.
material_note: ice_block01: dark frozen rock, blue-grey under a skin of rime - the cliff blocks that line the chasms.
why_this_one: Devias's second commonest object, 288 of them: the ice-rock cliffs every chasm is walled with.
effects_note: No arm in MuMain's WD_2DEVIAS switches (CreateObject :4668, MoveObject :3900, RenderObjectVisual :2819): one static mesh, no light, no blend mesh.
